async def act(page):
    # Click the 'MIT License' link to view the license file
    await page.get_by_role("link", name="MIT License").click()
    # Wait for the page to load
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    # Get the text content of the license file using accessibility tree-centric selectors
    # Try to find the license text in a code or pre element with appropriate roles
    license_text = ""
    # First, try to get by role 'code' (common for code blocks)
    code_elements = page.get_by_role("code")
    count = await code_elements.count()
    if count > 0:
        # Assume the first code element contains the license text
        license_text = await code_elements.first().text_content()
    # If no code role, try to get by role 'document' or 'article'
    if not license_text:
        document_elements = page.get_by_role("document")
        count = await document_elements.count()
        if count > 0:
            license_text = await document_elements.first().text_content()
    if not license_text:
        article_elements = page.get_by_role("article")
        count = await article_elements.count()
        if count > 0:
            license_text = await article_elements.first().text_content()
    # If still no text, use the main content area as a fallback
    if not license_text:
        main_elements = page.get_by_role("main")
        count = await main_elements.count()
        if count > 0:
            license_text = await main_elements.first().text_content()
    # Return the license text as the result
    return license_text
